heros.infro: Zāhir ud-Dīn Muhammad known as Babur became the first Mogul Emperor of India when he failed to reconquer the Central Asian lands that had been his father's. He sought territory to the southeast, and his attributes of fierce ambition and ruthless warfare and government led to his ruling most of northern India. He defeated the Afghan ruler of Delhi in 1526 beginning the 200-year-long Mogul empire in India.
heros.name: Babur
